requirements.requirement: Bind source bytes, dependency interfaces, compiler/syntax identities, target, flags, policy and document versions
requirements.scope: Frozen single-file or explicit source-set inputs; actual dependency interface context. Compiler ancestry is a declared trusted binary anchor.

requirements.requirement: Define IDs for bindings, declarations, overloads, types, traits and patterns
requirements.scope: Supported checked declarations and syntax patterns, including interface-only declarations. Unsupported categories and generated origin chains remain explicit limitations.

requirements.requirement: Unrelated declaration insertion preserves IDs where promised
Rename and lexical moves map or invalidate old IDs; no silent stale selection
requirements.scope: Renamed/moved IDs are invalidated; selection requires snapshot, ID, kind and exact content digest. Changed dependency interfaces invalidate stale content.

requirements.requirement: Unsaved overlays and invalid sources return versioned partial results with analysis status
requirements.scope: Disk-based overlay capture checks base bytes; explicit source-set bytes and supplied document versions are immutable inputs, not an assertion of current editor state.

requirements.requirement: Checked publication and immutable retrieval reject corruption
requirements.scope: Completed content-addressed publication marker and hash checks; no durable multi-file working-tree transaction claim.

not_claimed: unsupported inferred local types, exact token ranges or expanded origins
